requires.purpose: the subject of every decision is an AuthenticatedPrincipal; the host passes it in, so there is no package dependency

groups, lineage, tenants and membership status, adapted by the host to the AuthorisationDirectory port; approval requirements, safety periods, owners and recovery holds through the AuthorisationGovernance port

integration.consumers: domain capabilities describe their resources and ask for decisions through the public contract; they never read the authorisation schema
integration.composition: host supplies ports from a Nitro plugin; persistence follows ADR-0002; groups and memberships belong to Identity
